title: Group Goal-Events — Design Document
summary: Design document specifying friend/group formation, non-competitive goal-events, privacy-safe photo/location logging, feed, and certificates for Ritham.
notes: No frontmatter or ADR-style Context/Decision/Consequences sections, and no user-story/acceptance-criteria PRD structure. Classified SPEC over DOC/PRD because it contains concrete data-model specifications (certificate fields, feed card contents, copy table, upload/export flow steps) that read as implementation contracts rather than pure narrative or user-story requirements; per ambiguity rule (ADR > SPEC > PRD > DOC), SPEC was chosen as the higher-precedence competing signal over DOC/PRD.
